title: You Think Short-Term Memory Is One Box, Yet Eight Digits Proved It Has Four Rooms
description:
You lower the car radio just to see a highway exit! Yet volunteers chanted eight digits aloud without crashing logic! This is the true story of Alan Baddeley and Graham Hitch. Here is what went wrong in nineteen sixty-eight.
